verdict.rationale: Semgrep's docs mention a 'Triage findings' workflow (alerts, tickets) and an AI Assistant that reduces noise by ~20%, and community reports of building custom triage pipelines on SARIF output to surface the most relevant findings, suggesting some noise-reduction capability. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of an ignore-list, inline suppression, or baseline-scan mechanism to silence pre-existing/false-positive findings so only new ones alert, and community feedback repeatedly flags high false-positive rates as an ongoing pain point.
